newsitem.title: FRANCE: France arrests suspected Basque guerrilla leader.
newsitem.headline: France arrests suspected Basque guerrilla leader.

text.p: France on Tuesday arrested a suspected leader of the Basque separatist group who has been accused by Madrid of ordering an attempt to assassinate Spanish King Juan Carlos in 1995.
Police sources said Juan Luis Aguirre Lete, also known as Isuntza, was seized by customs agents in the Landes area of southwest France after a car chase along a highway near Benesse-Maremne.
Aguirre Lete, who had tried to drive past a customs check set up at a toll booth, was placed in detention by police in the nearby city of Bayonne.
Spain has accused Aguirre Lete of ordering the killing of King Juan Carlos at his holiday home on Palma de Majorca in August 1995. Spanish police foiled the assassination attempt.
ETA (Basque Homeland and Freedom) has killed nearly 800 people in a campaign for Basque independence which began in 1968.
